column51: The "GOTC" sheet is a comprehensive catalog documenting the Game of the Year (GOTY) awards across various years and categories. The sheet provides a structured overview of outstanding games that have earned prestigious honors in their respective genres.   It's consistently kept up-to-date, and a new GOTY entry is added once a year.   Each entry is accompanied with a game icon, that's created from scratch.
